title: Boltzmann counting in Hilbert space
summary: We introduce a geometric entropy for quantum preparations, defined as the logarithm of the Hilbert-space volume of pure states compatible with a given set of constraints. This construction extends Boltzmann's counting perspective to the quantum setting, where compatible states need not be orthogonal and the relevant notion of "number of states" is naturally replaced by a volume in state space. We analyze three classes of constraints: restriction to a subspace, fixed expectation values, and coarse-grained subsystem descriptions.
